title: Run Vision Observation over an authorized accepted photo
verify: The canonical vision_observation definition permits only speak, clarify, or strict model silence and cannot diagnose, recommend physical action, or widen the roster/provider policy.

The assembler resolves current ActorContext for the same active Plant, loads one accepted catalog row, contains its relative path under LOCAL_ARTIFACT_ROOT, and freshly verifies content type, size, and sha256 before provider I/O.

The provider receives the exact ordered VisionProviderRequestV1 plus one in-memory image matching photo:<photo_id>; no local path, filename, ActorContext, auth material, UI/chat, timeline replay, or arbitrary metadata crosses egress.

The provider-neutral Vision seam has no selected provider, model, or base URL; production is unbound and fail-closed, while explicit test fakes/spies prove typed success, timeout, provider failure, invalid output, and no fallback/fake production.

Strict result validation preserves the canonical matrix: speak maps one supported visible finding to a pending non-consumable MessageEnvelope plus VisionStateCandidateV1; clarify maps to a pending clarification envelope without candidate; silent returns neither artifact. For speak, low-confidence/uncertain findings use a hypothesis envelope claim only as transport metadata and TASK-035 persists them exactly as unknown, with no direct DB/Bus/UI/task/Safety effect here.

Missing or unavailable photo data returns context_denied/input_contract_violation before provider and runtime-audit I/O, with no clarification envelope, state candidate, or follow-up task; FT-016 may render an upload/reselect prompt and FT-012 owns any later follow-up task.
Post-I/O session/membership/grant/active-Plant guard and audit failure semantics match Agent Runtime; archive/revoke blocks handoff and restore does not replay it.

A deterministic outbound spy receives exactly one request with the freshly verified committed tomato-fixture bytes and produces runtime_decision=speak with audited envelope_ready, one valid pending MessageEnvelope, and one matching VisionStateCandidateV1; clarify and silent remain non-accepting fixture branches. Timeout/error/invalid output, post-I/O denial, audit failure, and unbound production fail closed with redacted evidence.

purpose: Add the canonical provider-neutral Vision Observation path that sends one authorized accepted local photo through a strict executor seam while preserving project authorization, privacy, audit, and pending-only authority boundaries.
success_outcome: Actual bytes from an authorized accepted Plant photo reach exactly one explicit outbound spy, and the committed tomato fixture yields runtime_decision=speak with audited envelope_ready, one schema-valid pending MessageEnvelope, and one matching VisionStateCandidateV1. Strict schemas, media integrity, authorization plus post-I/O recheck, timeout/error/invalid-output handling, redaction, unbound production, and no fallback/fake production are deterministic evidence; no provider, model, base URL, credential, egress, network call, or live smoke is required, and no branch gains Plant-state, Bus, UI, task, Safety, or confirmation effect.
anti_goals: No Plant-state table, conflict/promotion service, public model endpoint, Bus/UI publication, classifier policy, Safety/task/action effect, frontend, Companion, or dataset work.
No diagnosis taxonomy, physical-action recommendation, automatic background worker, provider file persistence/history, Agno memory/RAG/tools/Team, image rewrite, or path/URL egress.
No change to generic ProviderRequestV1 or the completed FT-007/FT-005 lifecycle and evidence.

stop_conditions: Correctness would require changing accepted photo identity/layout or generic Agent Runtime outcome/MessageEnvelope authority.

Current authorization and active-Plant state cannot be rechecked after provider I/O before handoff.
Deterministic acceptance would require a production fake/canned result, fallback, missing audit, or raw secret/provider/photo evidence.

constraints: Use exactly one internally assembled active-Plant plus accepted-photo request and one freshly verified in-memory media attachment; callers cannot submit context, refs, bytes, path, prompt, model, or schema.

Version-1 vision uses a strict provider-neutral executor seam: production remains unbound/fail-closed, tests inject explicit fakes/spies, and neither default provider selection nor fallback is allowed.

Preserve the exact result matrix: speak returns pending MessageEnvelope plus non-authoritative VisionStateCandidateV1, clarify returns only its pending envelope, and silent returns neither; persist or publish nothing from this task.
